description: INDIA. Computes stamp duty and the registration fee on a home purchase in the states and union territories whose official rates Payotte read (Kerala, Chandigarh, Odisha, Puducherry, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Maharashtra), on the higher of the price and the reference value, with women buyer rates and the Mumbai metro surcharge. Other states (Delhi, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu…) return "not computed" with no figure.

maharashtra_area.description: Maharashtra only: Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council/Nagar Panchayat/MMR rural, or Gram Panchayat area.

mumbai.description: Maharashtra only: property in Mumbai (BMC), 1% metro surcharge.

reference_value.description: State reference value (guidance value, circle rate…) in rupees, if known.

state.description: State or union territory (name, ISO code like KL, or a covered city like Mumbai).

woman_buyer.description: Woman buyer (reduced rate where the state text provides one).
